Applied Machine Learning Engineer Senior Consultant II (Software Engineering Focus)



At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life's uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers' evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection. 

 

 
Job Description 

 Machine Learning Software Engineer Senior Consultant II implements applications following 12-factor principles to build out the product and iterative enhancements. They own the full stack of software products and backend services. They leverage test driven development and continuous integration to ensure agility and quality of products. They actively participate in the decision-making process of the team ensuring that the simplest appropriate technology and design is chosen to meet user needs. 

 This is a software engineering-first role. Strong Java/Spring Boot development experience is required. Experience deploying Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions into production is highly desirable.

 Experience 

 

 • 3 or more years of experience 

 

 • Strong proficiency in Java 17+ and Spring Boot 4.x+ 

 

 • Proficiency in Python 

 

 • Experience deploying GenAI and/or machine learning systems into production. Experience building GenAI systems is preferred but not required. 

 

 • Prior experience building and/or supporting CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent).

 • Demonstrated experience supporting production applications, monitoring, and incident response

items: Organization: Applied Machine Learning Group (AMLG) → ML Platform
This is a high-leverage role designed for an expert who understands the deep technical stack required to shift ML models from research to global production

Reduce Systemic Risk: Implement a self-healing infrastructure layer that significantly reduces manual intervention for cluster-related failures
